+import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
+
+// Parse exactly one CSV record, allowing optional LF or CRLF termination.
+export function parseRecord(text) {
+  const fields = [];
+  let value = '', state = 'start';
+  for (let i = 0; i < text.length; i++) {
+    const c = text[i];
+    if (state === 'quoted') {
+      if (c === '"') {
+        if (text[i + 1] === '"') { value += '"'; i++; }
+        else state = 'closed';
+      } else value += c;
+      continue;
+    }
+    if (c === ',') { fields.push(value); value = ''; state = 'start'; }
+    else if (c === '\n' || c === '\r') {
+      const end = c === '\r' && text[i + 1] === '\n' ? i + 2 : i + 1;
+      if (end !== text.length) throw Error('multiple records or unquoted line break');
+      fields.push(value);
+      return fields;
+    } else if (c === '"' && state === 'start') state = 'quoted';
+    else {
+      if (state === 'closed' || c === '"') throw Error('invalid quoting');
+      state = 'plain'; value += c;
+    }
+  }
+  if (state === 'quoted') throw Error('unterminated quote');
+  return [...fields, value];
+}
+
+export function grade(input, stdout) {
+  let values, reason;
+  try {
+    values = parseRecord(stdout);
+    reason = JSON.stringify(values) === JSON.stringify(input.map(String))
+      ? 'ordered fields preserved' : 'field values or column order changed';
+  } catch (error) { reason = error.message; }
+  // Canonical presentation is separate from functional correctness.
+  const canonical = input.map(String).map(s => /[",\r\n]/.test(s)
+    ? '"' + s.replaceAll('"', '""') + '"' : s).join(',') + '\n';
+  return {functional: reason === 'ordered fields preserved', reason,
+    canonical: stdout === canonical};
+}
+
+export function testGrader() {
+  const input = ['東京', 'a,b', 'last \t'];
+  const correct = '東京,"a,b",last \t\n';
+  assert.equal(grade(input, correct).functional, true);
+  assert.equal(grade(input, '"東京","a,b","last \t"\r\n').functional, true);
+  assert.equal(grade(input, '"東京","a,b","last \t"\r\n').canonical, false);
+  assert.equal(grade(input, correct.trimEnd() + '\n').functional, false);
+  assert.equal(grade(input, '東京,a,b,last \t\n').functional, false);
+  assert.equal(grade(input, 'last \t,"a,b",東京\n').functional, false);
+  assert.equal(grade(['a\rb'], 'a\rb\n').functional, false);
+  assert.equal(grade(['a\rb'], '"a\rb"\n').functional, true);
+  assert.equal(grade(['a"b'], '"a""b"\n').functional, true);
+  assert.equal(grade(['a'], '"a\n').functional, false);
+  assert.equal(grade(['a'], 'a\nb\n').functional, false);
+}
